$comment: Dependency manifest for cross-compiling UltraCanvas's rendering stack to
.github/workflows/ios-build.yml runs for the simulator and for devices.
The same set as the Android manifest (UltraCanvas/OS/Android/packaging/
vcpkg.json): each entry is a pkg_check_modules call in
UltraCanvas/CMakeLists.txt, and libvips is part of UltraCanvas on every
platform, with the codecs the Android build carries. cairo is built
without its Quartz surface and fonts (vcpkg turns those on for macOS
only): cairo-quartz.h includes ApplicationServices, which iOS lacks, and
the iOS backend presents an image surface (iOSPortInvestigation.md 3.3).

dependencies.$comment: librsvg's image loader, for the bitmaps an SVG embeds: PNG and JPEG are what those are. Not its default TIFF loader: its tools failed to link on iOS with 'library tiff not found', and libvips reads TIFF itself.
dependencies.name: gdk-pixbuf

net.description: UltraNet support (-DULTRACANVAS_ENABLE_NET=ON): OpenSSL for TLS (the macOS SecureTransport file does not build for iOS), c-ares for DNS, the vendored curl's dependencies.
